findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_projects, avery_status, avery_reach_out · Private data: list_projects, preview_companies, search_companies, search_buildings, find_contact, get_record, research_company, add_blocklist, annotate_companies, get_annotations, flag_company_fact, match_company_list, add_to_project, log_touch, run_project, save_project_search, set_record_stage, correct_record_fact · Public sink: project_leads, find_contact, research_company, avery_status, avery_reach_out, avery_accept_intro, create_watch_webhook, toggle_watch_webhook, test_watch_webhook, delete_watch_webhook, flag_company_fact, log_touch, research_building_owners, correct_record_fact · Destructive: remove_blocklist, delete_watch_webhook, run_project, project_run_status, create_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_projects, avery_status, avery_reach_out · Private data: list_projects, preview_companies, search_companies, search_buildings, find_contact, get_record, research_company, add_blocklist, annotate_companies, get_annotations, flag_company_fact, match_company_list, add_to_project, log_touch, run_project, save_project_search, set_record_stage, correct_record_fact · Public sink: project_leads, find_contact, research_company, avery_status, avery_reach_out, avery_accept_intro, create_watch_webhook, toggle_watch_webhook, test_watch_webhook, delete_watch_webhook, flag_company_fact, log_touch, research_building_owners, correct_record_fact · Destructive: remove_blocklist, delete_watch_webhook, run_project, project_run_status, create_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
